Moussa Keita  
Email: moussa.keita@example.com | Phone: +972-52-345-6789 | Location: Tel Aviv, Israel | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/moussa-keita  

A results-oriented platform engineer with a focus on scalable cloud infrastructure and automation, currently supporting FinTech Innovators Ltd. in delivering robust financial technology solutions. With a background in deploying and optimizing cloud-native systems, I bring a blend of technical expertise and collaborative problem-solving to ensure reliable, cost-effective platform operations. My work bridges development and operations, emphasizing seamless integration and proactive system resilience.  

At FinTech Innovators Ltd., I serve as a Cloud Support Engineer, managing GCP infrastructure and maintaining Kubernetes clusters. My responsibilities include monitoring system performance, optimizing cloud costs, and ensuring high availability for mission-critical applications. I’ve contributed to streamlining deployment workflows by integrating automated testing and improving cluster scalability. Prior to this, I worked as a DevOps Engineer Intern at AfriPay Solutions, where I automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and implemented monitoring solutions using Prometheus. This role required collaboration with cross-functional teams to align infrastructure strategies with business goals.  

In my earlier role as a Software Developer Intern at AfriPay Solutions, I assisted in deploying backend services using AWS EC2 and supported the setup of foundational CI/CD pipelines. This experience solidified my understanding of cloud environments and the importance of infrastructure-as-code practices in maintaining consistent, reproducible deployments.  

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Université Cheikh Anta Diop, 2022.  

Technical Skills  
- **Cloud Platforms**: AWS EC2, GCP, Kubernetes (cluster maintenance, scaling, and security configurations)  
- **Infrastructure Automation**: Terraform (production-grade IaC for resource provisioning), GitLab CI (CI/CD pipeline integration)  
- **Containerization**: Docker (container orchestration, image optimization, and service deployment)  
- **System Monitoring**: Prometheus (metric collection, alert rule creation, and anomaly detection)  
- **Scripting & Tools**: Python (automation scripts for repetitive tasks, API integrations)  
- **Linux Administration**: System configuration, user management, and performance tuning for server environments  
- **Monitoring & Alerting**: Centralized dashboards, incident response, and SLA compliance tracking  

Projects  
- **GCP Cost Optimization Initiative**: Analyzed and reduced cloud spending by 15% through resource tagging, reserved instance allocation, and idle instance shutdown scripts.  
- **Kubernetes Cluster Upgrade**: Led the migration of legacy workloads to a managed Kubernetes service, improving deployment efficiency and reducing downtime by 20%.  
- **CI/CD Pipeline Enhancement**: Integrated GitLab CI with Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning, cutting manual setup time by 30% and improving deployment reliability.
